Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator made a critical error in Step 1 by incorrectly identifying the "first National Geographic short on YouTube" as "Human Origins 101". This identification is factually incorrect; "Human Origins 101" is a 3-minute educational video released in 2018, but it is not the first short film released by National Geographic on the platform (which would likely be much older or have a different format/title). Because the entire investigation was built upon this false premise, all subsequent steps searching for "#9" within that specific video were futile. The concept of "#9" in the context of a marine life query (implied by the Monterey Bay Aquarium reference) suggests the user might be referring to a list of marine animals (perhaps a "Top 10" video), not a human evolution documentary. The Orchestrator failed to verify the claim about the "first short" before directing the team down the wrong path.
